description: Look up any Nomos ERR_* failure code, TC-AGT-* vector, or nomos verify gate rejection to retrieve its root cause and non-bypassing AST remediation. Example: error_code='ERR_CROSS_PLANE_MUTATION' returns the remediation guide. Use when troubleshooting a verify failure or pre-commit hook error. Do NOT use when browsing the full catalog of 42 gates by Law or category without an error (use inspect_dod_gates instead).

error_code.description: Optional ERR_* identifier such as ERR_CROSS_PLANE_MUTATION or ERR_COGNITIVE_DEBT.

error_log.description: Optional raw error message, gate name, or pre-commit output snippet.

name: diagnose_nomos_error
title: Inspect Nomos Gate or ERR_* Failure Remediation
